value.title: New Students and Misunderstandings
value.synopsis: As a new school year starts, both Atsushi and Atsumi face misunderstandings with the new batch of students.

value.title: Atsushi and Bicycles
value.synopsis: Atsushi's friends try to teach him how to ride a bike without training wheels.

value.title: Atsushi and Dreams
value.synopsis: Atsushi and Atsumi think about what they want to do in the future.

value.title: Snacks and Cheering
value.synopsis: As Atsumi ends up making too many snacks for Atsushi and his friends, she invites over Sayo, who continues to misunderstand who Atsushi really is.

value.title: Family and Hot Springs
value.synopsis: Atsushi, Atsumi and their family go to a hot spring inn where Atsumi's height becomes a bother for her.

value.title: Atsushi and the Sports Festival, Part 1
value.synopsis: Atsumi has to act as Atsushi's parent so he can participate in his school's sports festival.

value.title: Atsushi and the Sports Festival, Part 2
value.synopsis: Atsushi and Atsumi have lunch with Sayo before participating in a relay race.

value.title: Misunderstanding and Truth
value.synopsis: Sayo learns the truth that Atsushi is Atsumi's little brother.

value.title: Atsushi and Hand-Me-Downs
value.synopsis: Atsushi wears some clothes handed down from Take, which prove to be a bit controversial.

value.title: Atsushi and Culture Fairs
value.synopsis: Atsushi and his friends go to Atsumi's school culture festival where he runs into Sayo.

value.title: Big Sister and Little Sister
value.synopsis: Atsumi and Sayo spend some time together

value.title: Atsushi and Chases
value.synopsis: A game of hide and seek soon turns into a frantic escape from the cops for Atsushi.

value.title: Atsushi and Bye-Byes
value.synopsis: Atsushi joins Atsumi and Sayo to a family restaurant.
